name: Par14a-Database
description: Database of the §14a EnWG grid fees (modules 1, 2, 3) of all German distribution system operators, one SQLite release per year, with a search website.
description_good_justification: The README states what the project does: a database of the §14a EnWG grid fees (modules 1, 2, 3) of all German distribution system operators, one SQLite release per year, with a search page. English summary: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/README.md#english-summary
interact_justification: README explains how to download (releases), query (website), submit price sheets (issue form) and contribute: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/README.md
contribution_requirements_justification: Requirements for data, code style (Ruff), tests and licensing: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#anforderungen-an-beiträge
floss_license_justification: Code under MIT (https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/LICENSE), data under CC BY 4.0 (https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/DATA_LICENSE).
floss_license_osi_justification: The code license MIT is OSI-approved. CC BY 4.0 applies only to the data.
documentation_basics_justification: README documents download, the website, the data layout, the scripts and how to add a new year: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/README.md
documentation_interface_justification: The external interface is the SQLite schema and the CSV format, documented in https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/schema.sql and https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/README.md#aufbau
sites_https_justification: Repository, releases and website (https://the78mole.github.io/Par14a-Database/) are served only via HTTPS by GitHub.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are searchable, addressable by URL and open to everyone: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/issues
english_justification: The main documentation is German; English summaries are in https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/README.md#english-summary, https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md and https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/SECURITY.md. Bug reports and comments in English are explicitly welcome (CONTRIBUTING.md).
maintained_justification: Actively maintained, data and code updated several times per month: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/commits/main
repo_track_justification: Git tracks every change with author and time.
repo_interim_justification: All interim work is on public branches and pull requests: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/pulls?q=is%3Apr
version_unique_justification: Every database build has a unique version from commit date and commit hash (e.g. 2026-11-12+837ea02), stored in table meta and in the release notes: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/scripts/build_db.py, https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
version_semver_justification: The data releases are continuously updated datasets; the version is date plus commit hash instead of SemVer.
version_tags_justification: One rolling release per year (daten-<year>) whose asset is replaced on every data change; the version is recorded in the database and release notes, not as a separate git tag.
release_notes_justification: Each release has notes with its version and the latest changes to the data, generated by https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/releases
release_notes_vulns_justification: There have been no publicly known vulnerabilities in the project's results.
report_process_justification: Bugs and wrong values are reported as GitHub issues, price sheets via an issue form: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#preisblätter-und-datenfehler
report_responses_justification: All bug reports and questions by third parties were answered, e.g. https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/issues/12
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are answered in the issue tracker, e.g. https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/issues/12 (data license, implemented in #13).
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/security/advisories/new, described in https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received so far. SECURITY.md commits to an acknowledgement within 7 days.
build_justification: python scripts/build_db.py builds the SQLite databases, python scripts/build_web.py the website; both run in GitHub Actions: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
build_common_tools_justification: The build uses only the standard Python interpreter and GitHub Actions.
test_justification: pytest suite in https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/tests (data validation of all CSV files and end-to-end build of SQLite and website), run with python -m pytest as documented in https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/README.md#entwicklung
test_most_justification: The tests cover the build scripts, the time-window conversion and every data row, but not the helper scripts for crawling and reading PDFs.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Lint and tests run on every pull request and push: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: New functionality and bug fixes require automated tests in the same pull request: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#anforderungen-an-beiträge
tests_are_added_justification: The test suite was added in https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/pull/19; the pull request template asks for tests on every change.
warnings_justification: Ruff (Pyflakes, Bugbear, Bandit rules) in CI, pytest treats warnings as errors: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/pyproject.toml
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any Ruff finding or warning; the code is currently warning-free.
warnings_strict_justification: pytest runs with filterwarnings=error, Ruff findings fail CI; exceptions only with a rule-specific noqa and reason.
know_secure_design_justification: Self-assessment: the primary developer knows secure design and applies it, e.g. least-privilege workflow tokens per job, actions pinned by SHA, no secrets in the repository (S3 access only via environment variables), the website renders data only via DOM APIs.
know_common_errors_justification: Self-assessment: the primary developer knows common errors such as XSS and injection and counters them: parameterised SQL with validated column names, URL scheme check on the website, no shell=True, CodeQL and Bandit rules in CI.
crypto_published_justification: The project implements no cryptography and its security does not depend on it. SHA-256 (Python hashlib) is only used to detect changed price-sheet PDFs; transport security is TLS provided by curl/requests and GitHub.
crypto_call_justification: The project implements no cryptography and its security does not depend on it. SHA-256 (Python hashlib) is only used to detect changed price-sheet PDFs; transport security is TLS provided by curl/requests and GitHub.
crypto_floss_justification: The project implements no cryptography and its security does not depend on it. SHA-256 (Python hashlib) is only used to detect changed price-sheet PDFs; transport security is TLS provided by curl/requests and GitHub.
crypto_keylength_justification: The project implements no cryptography and its security does not depend on it. SHA-256 (Python hashlib) is only used to detect changed price-sheet PDFs; transport security is TLS provided by curl/requests and GitHub.
crypto_working_justification: The project implements no cryptography and its security does not depend on it. SHA-256 (Python hashlib) is only used to detect changed price-sheet PDFs; transport security is TLS provided by curl/requests and GitHub.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The project implements no cryptography and its security does not depend on it. SHA-256 (Python hashlib) is only used to detect changed price-sheet PDFs; transport security is TLS provided by curl/requests and GitHub.
crypto_pfs_justification: The project implements no cryptography and its security does not depend on it. SHA-256 (Python hashlib) is only used to detect changed price-sheet PDFs; transport security is TLS provided by curl/requests and GitHub.
crypto_random_justification: The project generates no keys or nonces.
delivery_mitm_justification: Releases, repository and website are delivered via HTTPS only (GitHub).
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are fetched over HTTP: PDF hashes are in the repository, tool hashes in requirements-dev.txt, actions are pinned by commit SHA.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no known unpatched vulnerabilities.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerabilities have been reported.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials in the repository; local .env/.envrc are ignored (https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.gitignore), scripts read S3 credentials only from environment variables.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (Python, JavaScript, Actions; security-extended) on every pull request and weekly: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml; Ruff with Bandit rules: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security-extended queries and Ruff's Bandit (S) rules look for common vulnerabilities.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: All findings were fixed or justified in place when the analysis was introduced (https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/pull/19); CI blocks new findings.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL and Ruff run on every pull request and push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: No fuzzing or other dynamic analysis tool yet. The tests do build the databases and the website from all data on every change.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The production scripts do not use assertions; checks are in the test suite.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis tool is used yet.
osps_ac_01_01_justification: GitHub requires two-factor authentication for the account of the only collaborator (the maintainer); no other accounts have access.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: GitHub assigns no permissions to new collaborators until the owner grants them; escalated permissions only after review: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#vergabe-erweiterter-rechte
osps_ac_03_01_justification: Ruleset 'main schützen' on the default branch (template: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main-schuetzen.json) requires a pull request for every change to main.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: Ruleset 'main schützen' on the default branch (template: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main-schuetzen.json) blocks deletion and force-pushes of main.
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow interpolates untrusted metadata (branch names, titles, commit messages) into run steps; the DCO check passes SHAs via environment variables: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/dco.yml. CodeQL analyses the workflows.
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull requests run only with the pull_request trigger (read-only token, no secrets); there is no pull_request_target. Write permissions exist only in release.yml and pages.yml after merge to main.
osps_br_03_01_justification: Repository, issues and website are served only via HTTPS (github.com, the78mole.github.io).
osps_br_03_02_justification: Releases are distributed via HTTPS from GitHub Releases, with SHA-256 checksums and Sigstore provenance: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/docs/SICHERHEIT.md#2-release-anhänge-prüfen
osps_br_07_01_justification: No secrets in the repository; .env/.envrc are ignored, secret scanning with push protection is enabled, scripts read credentials only from environment variables: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/docs/SICHERHEIT.md#5-umgang-mit-geheimnissen
osps_do_01_01_justification: User guide for download, the website, the data layout and querying: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/README.md
osps_le_02_02_justification: The released assets are data under CC BY 4.0, which the FSF lists as a free license: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/DATA_LICENSE
osps_le_03_02_justification: Every release carries DATA_LICENSE next to the databases, and each database states its license in table meta.
osps_qa_01_02_justification: Git history with author and time of every change: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/commits/main
osps_qa_02_01_justification: Direct dependencies: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/requirements.txt (helper scripts) and https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/requirements-dev.in / requirements-dev.txt (lint and tests); building the databases needs only the Python standard library.
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project consists of a single repository.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: The repository contains no generated executables; databases and website are built in CI and published as release assets / Pages, dist/ is ignored.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The only binary files are small website icons (web/*.png, web/favicon.ico); no unreviewable binaries such as archives or compiled code.
osps_ac_04_01_justification: Repository default workflow permissions are read-only, and every workflow sets top-level permissions: contents: read.
osps_br_02_01_justification: Each database build has a unique version (commit date + hash) in table meta and in the release notes: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/scripts/build_db.py
osps_br_04_01_justification: Release notes list the version and the latest changes to the data: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml, https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/releases
osps_br_05_01_justification: Dependencies are installed with pip from hash-pinned requirements files; actions are pinned by commit SHA and updated by Renovate.
osps_br_06_01_justification: Each database has a SHA-256 file and signed build provenance (actions/attest-build-provenance, Sigstore): https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
osps_do_07_01_justification: Build and test instructions with required dependencies: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/README.md#entwicklung
osps_le_01_01_justification: Every commit in a pull request must carry a Signed-off-by line (DCO), enforced by the required check https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/dco.yml, documented in https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#signed-off-by-dco
osps_qa_03_01_justification: Ruleset 'main schützen' on the default branch (template: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main-schuetzen.json) requires the CI, CodeQL, DCO and dependency review checks to pass.
osps_qa_06_01_justification: The test suite runs on every pull request as a required check: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
osps_sa_02_01_justification: External interfaces of the released assets: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/docs/ARCHITEKTUR.md#3-externe-schnittstellen-der-ergebnisse and https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/schema.sql
osps_vm_01_01_justification: Coordinated disclosure with response times (7 days acknowledgement, 14 days assessment, fix target 60 days): https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/SECURITY.md
osps_vm_04_01_justification: Fixed vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/security/advisories (none so far).
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Each job declares only the permissions it needs (e.g. contents: write, id-token: write and attestations: write only in the release job; pages: write only in the pages job).
osps_br_01_04_justification: No workflow takes collaborator input (workflow_dispatch has no inputs); the only event data used are commit SHAs, passed via environment variables.
osps_br_02_02_justification: Each asset is named after its year and carries its unique version and commit in table meta; the .sha256 file and the signed provenance bind it to the build.
osps_do_03_02_justification: gh attestation verify shows the workflow and commit that built the asset: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/docs/SICHERHEIT.md#2-release-anhänge-prüfen
osps_do_05_01_justification: Only the current state is supported; a year is maintained at least until its end and the release notes state when it is no longer updated: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/SECURITY.md#unterstützte-versionen
osps_qa_02_02_justification: The released assets are data files (SQLite) and a static website, not compiled software.
osps_qa_04_02_justification: The project consists of a single repository.
osps_qa_07_01_justification: Single-maintainer project: there is no second human who could approve the maintainer's own changes. Changes by others are always reviewed by the maintainer.
osps_vm_04_02_justification: The released assets are data without bundled software components, so there are no component vulnerabilities to account for in VEX.
osps_vm_05_02_justification: No open finding of severity moderate or higher affecting the results may exist before a release: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/docs/SICHERHEIT.md#4-regeln-für-abhängigkeiten-und-analysebefunde
osps_vm_05_03_justification: Dependency review blocks pull requests introducing vulnerable or non-free dependencies (required check): https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml
osps_vm_06_02_justification: CodeQL and Ruff run on every pull request; the ruleset blocks merging on Ruff findings and CodeQL alerts of medium or higher: https://github.com/the78mole/Par14a-Database/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
